theorem lg_target {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {x : K} {m n : ℕ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h'x : x < 1) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by
  have hmn : m ≤ n := Finset.Ico.mono_left m n
  have h1 : x ≠ 1 := by contrapositive; intro h; rw [h] at h'x; exact lt_irrefl _ h'x
  have h_sum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i = (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) := geom_sum_Ico'.mpr ⟨h1, hmn⟩
  have h_denom_pos : 0 < 1 - x := by rw [sub_lt]; exact lt_trans hx h'x
  have h_num_le : x ^ m - x ^ n ≤ x ^ m := by rw [sub_le]; exact pow_le_pow_of_le hx (le_refl _) (le_trans hx h'x)
  have h_div_le : (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by {
    rw [div_le_iff h_denom_pos];
    exact le_add_right (le_zero (x ^ n)) (x ^ m)
  }
  exact le_trans h_sum h_div_le
